events.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Winner
events.description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Spain and France lead trader consensus at 15.6% and 15.3% implied probabilities for the 2026 FIFA World Cup title, reflecting their dominant UEFA qualification campaigns—both topping groups with 16 points—bolstered by deep squads featuring stars like Mbappé, Yamal, and Pedri. Recent friendlies, including France's 2-1 win over Brazil on March 26, have tightened the race atop the market, while England's perfect 24-point group haul places them third at 11.3%. Defending champions Argentina (9.0%) and Brazil (8.6%) trail after grinding through grueling CONMEBOL qualifiers, finishing first and fifth respectively amid stiff regional competition. The bunched odds underscore a hyper-competitive 48-team field post-final qualifiers on March 31 and group draw, where favorable paths for European elites balance South American pedigree and surprise qualifiers like Cape Verde.
